integrity: Symbolic proof and direct exhaustive finite-field checks; checks do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The coefficient field has the same odd characteristic as the elementary abelian quandle group.
No claim for non-elementary p-groups, characteristic two, or coefficient characteristic different from p.
Nonzero idempotents form a noncanonically identified midpoint quandle, not a canonically coordinatized K-vector space.
Published characteristic-three R3 classification covers the rank-one p=3 special case.
The full text of one relevant 2026 Fourier-analysis preprint was not inspected; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Modular idempotent quandles of elementary-abelian midpoint algebras
